summary: Clarify full-node placement by text order; part-of in change clauses even when the entity is reused; pre-apposition modifiers go on the apposition noun; have-org-role-91 holder is always ARG1; habitual covers production practices incl. nominals, and content verbs of publications are process.

edits.old: Write an entity's full node (name, apposition) at its first occurrence in reading order; later mentions are re-entrancies.
edits.new: Write an entity's full node (name, apposition, all modifiers) at its first mention in the order of the words of the sentence (text order, not graph order), even when that mention sits deeper in the graph; every other mention is a bare variable.

edits.old: the subject is `:part-of` on X, not its own argument and not an inverse `:part`.
edits.new: the subject is `:part-of` on X, not its own argument and not an inverse `:part`, even when it also fills a role elsewhere (that role is then a re-entrancy).

edits.old:
`:ARG1-of (i / identity-91 :ARG2 <head noun with all its
modifiers>)` on the named entity.
edits.new:
`:ARG1-of (i / identity-91 :ARG2 <head noun with all its
modifiers>)` on the named entity; modifiers written before the apposition noun (的-phrases, 旗下, property words) go on that noun, not on the entity.

an organisation or periodical publishing,
   reporting, compiling, broadcasting)? → `habitual`. Only verbs of publishing or reporting; the capacity or content of a

edits.new:
